exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Inviting a Friend to a Match
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Shen Qi: Hi, Amy. Did you hear there's a soccer game this weekend?
Amy: Really? Where is it?
Shen Qi: At the Wuhan Stadium, on Saturday afternoon.
Amy: That sounds fun. Who is playing?
Shen Qi: Wuhan against Guangzhou. Would you like to come along?
Amy: I'd love to! What time does it start?
Shen Qi: At three o'clock. Let's meet at the gate at two thirty.
Amy: Great. See you then!
exercises.translation_cn: 申奇问 Amy 周末有场足球赛;在武汉体育场,周六下午;武汉对广州;申奇邀她一起去;Amy 很乐意;比赛三点开始;两点半在门口见。

questions.stem: What event is Shen Qi inviting Amy to?
Where will the game take place?
Which two teams are playing?
What time does the game start?
Where will they meet?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Volleyball Legend
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lang Ping is loved by volleyball fans both at home and abroad.
As a player, she brought honour and glory to her country.
As a coach, she led the team to medals at the Olympics.
When two key players were lost before a big match, she did not lose heart.
She believed her young players could win if they worked as a team.
exercises.translation_cn: 郎平深受国内外排球迷喜爱;作为球员,她为祖国带来荣誉;作为教练,她带队在奥运会上夺牌;大赛前失去两名主力,她没有泄气;她相信只要团结,年轻队员就能赢。

questions.stem: Who loves Lang Ping, according to the passage?
options: Volleyball fans at home and abroad.

questions.stem: What did she do as a player?
options: She brought honour to her country.

questions.stem: What did she lead her team to as a coach?
How did she react when two key players were lost?
What did Lang Ping believe about her young players?
options: They could win by working as a team.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 At the Gym
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Jack: Wow, this is a wonderful gym, isn't it?
Dave: Yes, it's great. Is this your first time here?
Jack: Actually, it is. You come here often, don't you?
Dave: Yes, at least three times a week.
Jack: You've lost some weight, haven't you?
Dave: I have. All that fat has become muscle now.
Jack: It won't make me too tired, will it?
Dave: Maybe at first, but you'll get used to it.
exercises.translation_cn: Jack 觉得健身房很棒;这是他第一次来;Dave 常来,每周至少三次;Jack 说 Dave 瘦了;Dave 说脂肪变成了肌肉;Jack 担心太累;Dave 说开始会,但会习惯。

questions.stem: Is this Jack's first time at the gym?
How often does Dave go to the gym?
options: At least three times a week.

questions.stem: What has happened to Dave's body?
What is Jack worried about?
What does Dave say about feeling tired?
options: He will get used to it.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Why I Jog
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: My favourite way to stay healthy is jogging.
Every morning I run slowly around the park for half an hour.
Jogging is good for my body and helps me deal with stress.
After a hard day at school, a short run always clears my mind.
I don't run to win a medal; I run to feel happy and fit.
exercises.translation_cn: 我最喜欢的健康方式是慢跑;每天早晨绕公园慢跑半小时;慢跑有益身体,还能缓解压力;辛苦一天后,短跑总能让头脑清醒;我跑步不是为了奖牌,而是为了快乐和健康。

questions.stem: What is the speaker's favourite way to stay healthy?
When does the speaker jog?
Besides the body, what else does jogging help with?
What does a short run do after a hard day?
Why does the speaker run?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Talking About Fair Play
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Max: A player should never pretend to fall down, even to help the team.
Lily: Exactly. Cheating is always wrong.
Cao Jing: But an athlete should also do his best to win for the fans.
Max: Doing your best is fine, but you must play fair.
Lily: Right. The audience wants honest games.
Cao Jing: I see what you mean. A win by cheating is not a real win.
Max: That's true. Good sportsmanship matters more than the score.
Lily: I agree with that completely.
exercises.translation_cn: Max 说球员不该假摔,哪怕为了帮队;Lily 赞同,作弊总是错的;曹静说运动员也该为球迷尽力争胜;Max 说尽力可以但要公平;Lily 说观众想看诚实的比赛;曹静认同,靠作弊赢不算真赢;Max 说体育精神比比分更重要;Lily 完全同意。

questions.stem: What does Max think a player should never do?
What is Lily's opinion about cheating?
What does Cao Jing first say an athlete should do?
options: Do his best to win for the fans.

questions.stem: What does the audience want, according to Lily?
What do they finally agree on?
options: Good sportsmanship matters more than the score.
The score is all that counts.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Tip for Staying Fit
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who wants to stay fit.
Don't try to do too much exercise all at once.
It is better to train a little every day rather than for hours once a week.
Choose a sport you enjoy, like jogging, badminton, or swimming.
When exercise is fun, you will keep doing it and stay healthy.
exercises.translation_cn: 给想保持健康的人一个小贴士:别一次做太多运动;每天练一点,比一周一次练几个小时更好;选一项你喜欢的运动,比如慢跑、羽毛球或游泳;当运动有趣时,你就会坚持下去,保持健康。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
options: Anyone who wants to stay fit.

questions.stem: What does the speaker warn against?
options: Doing too much exercise all at once.

questions.stem: What is better than training for hours once a week?
What kind of sport should you choose?
What happens when exercise is fun?
options: You keep doing it and stay healthy.
